utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I heard—should be soon, maybe at the next meeting. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the title.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — just let me know the title when you hear it, and I’ll spread the word about the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep my ears open and tell you the second I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that sounds perfect for a busy month. What’s the title?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t picked a title yet, but I’ll check with Mara and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just let me know when you hear back from Mara.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the title yet, but I’ll ask around while I’m out. If Oren’s leaning cozy, maybe we’ll know soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still Thursday evening at Oren’s, then? I just want to make sure that’s the real plan and not up in the air.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that still sounds like the plan for Thursday evening at Oren’s, unless I hear otherwise. I’ll check around and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work as long as it doesn’t land on school pickup day.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works — I’ll avoid school pickup day when I pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — that should make it easier for me to join.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Pia — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I can check with Quinn. I just want to make sure the details are sorted before Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Pia — thanks for checking with Quinn. Just let me know when you’ve got the details sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure yet—I still need to ask around about which novel we’re picking. If I hear back, I’ll let you know the time and whether it’s final.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll check with the book club and let you know what we decide, and I’ll pass along your dessert offer too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Let me know what the club settles on, and I’ll bring dessert if it’s a go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana—that sounds perfect. I’ll come when I can and bring a dessert if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Dane. Just send me the time for next Thursday and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll send the time for next Thursday, and I’ll bring a dessert too if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—if the book club needs any tools or a hand with setup, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind of you. I’ll pass it along if I hear they need help with setup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — happy to help if they need anything for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the next meeting date and whether snacks are needed this time, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — I might miss the update, so please remind me if I forget. Appreciate you checking on the meeting date and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I’ll remind you and confirm the meeting date and snacks once I check.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still meeting at my place, and I’ve got the snacks and extra tea ready. If you want, I can bring the full book list next time too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds perfect, Cleo — thanks! I’ll let everyone know we’re still on for Thursday at your place, and they should come hungry for tea and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—see you Thursday, and I’ll keep the tea hot and the snacks ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’d like to hear what you all are reading lately.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’ve been swapping a few good picks lately — I can check the exact room and time if you want to come by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be lovely, Opal. If you can check the room and time, I’d be glad to come by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I might sit this one out, but I appreciate you including me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli — no pressure at all, and you’re always welcome if you change your mind. I’ll keep you posted about Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’d appreciate that — please keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — it’s Thursday at 7:00 PM at Quinn’s place, 14 Maple Street. If transportation is tricky, I can help figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Pia — Thursday at 7:00 at Quinn’s place works for me. I appreciate the ride help if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — I’ll keep an eye out in case anyone needs a ride plan. See you Thursday at 7 at Quinn’s place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’d like to hear what you all are reading lately.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the book club and let you know what we decide.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club details you want me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you check which mystery novel Oren’s leaning toward first? Then maybe we can pin down a time that works for everyone, especially around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check Oren’s mystery pick first, then I’ll see what time works best around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking a new novel this month—sounds like it could be a good one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, a new novel sounds good. Do you know when and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not sure yet, but I’m checking the room and time now. I’ll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for your place, and do you want me to bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — my place is still good, and snacks would be great. Thanks, Mina; I’ll have the chairs set up before everyone gets here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring snacks then. See you at your place before book club.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s moved to Thursday at the cafe now. I’ll let you know the book once the group decides.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, thanks — Thursday at the cafe sounds right. Just let me know the book once they decide, and I’ll keep it noted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as the group picks the book.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate the invite, and I’ll let you know if I’m able to make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know what the book club decides.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate that — I’ll check in when I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — book club is Thursday at 7:00 PM at my place, 14 Maple Street, and you’re very welcome to come. If getting there is tricky, I can help you figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll stop by. I still haven’t heard the title, but I’ll ask around while I’m out and see what Oren’s leaning toward.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’m glad you can make it, Ira! I’ll see if I can pin down the title before Thursday and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking on the room and time for the book club. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just let me know when you’ve got the room and time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’m checking now and I’ll tell you as soon as I know the room and time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the snacks and extra tea ready, and I can bring the full reading list next time too. If you want, I can also pick up anything else for book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, thanks—just let me know the date first so I can make sure it doesn’t land on school pickup day.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ll check the date and let you know soon so we can avoid school pickup day.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So is the book club actually picking the new read soon, or is that still just a maybe? And what time is next Thursday at your place?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I’m in—just need the title and the time for next Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it is happening soon — can you confirm the time for next Thursday, and do we already have a title yet?
